items.claim: CFO 表示 2026 全年財測維持不變
items.quote: Our full year 2026 guidance remains unchanged.
items.speaker: Alexander Bradley (CFO)

items.claim: 財測現假設淨關稅影響 6,000 萬至 8,000 萬美元（含 IEEPA 淨回收與下半年 Section 301 假設）
items.quote: assumes a net tariff impact of $60 million to $80 million
items.speaker: Alexander Bradley (CFO)

items.claim: Q3 出貨量指引 3.9–4.5 GW
items.quote: volumes sold between 3.9 gigawatts and 4.5 gigawatts
items.speaker: Alexander Bradley (CFO)

items.claim: Q3 調整後 EBITDA 指引 6.25–7.75 億美元
items.quote: EBITDA between $625 million and $775 million
items.speaker: Alexander Bradley (CFO)

items.claim: 印度產能假設主要在國內短週期市場銷售、高稼動率；上半年訂單約 1.1 GW
items.quote: totaled approximately 1.1 gigawatts
items.speaker: Alexander Bradley (CFO)

items.claim: Q2 毛利率約 57%
items.quote: expanded gross margin to approximately 57%
items.speaker: Mark Widmar (CEO)

items.claim: CFO 拆解毛利率年增原因之一：約 8,900 萬美元 IEEPA 關稅淨利益（原文金額 $89 在上一行）
items.quote: million net IEEPA tariff-related benefit
items.speaker: Alexander Bradley (CFO)

items.claim: 毛利率另一拆解項：符合 45X 稅額抵減的模組組合提高
items.quote: higher mix of modules qualifying for Section 45X tax credits
items.speaker: Alexander Bradley (CFO)

items.claim: IEEPA 淨關稅利益為目前估計，後續可能調整
items.quote: remains subject to refinement as
items.speaker: Alexander Bradley (CFO)

items.claim: Q2 調整後 EBITDA 6.44 億美元，高於先前預覽區間上緣
items.quote: above the high end of our previously communicated
items.speaker: Alexander Bradley (CFO)

items.claim: 部分美國境內運費已接近國際海運成本（因模組交付地點改變）
items.quote: domestic freight costs are now approaching
items.speaker: Alexander Bradley (CFO)

items.claim: 東南亞廠低稼動每季約 3,000 萬美元，約一半為現金、一半非現金
items.quote: somewhere around $30 million quarter of underutilization
items.speaker: Alexander Bradley (CFO)

items.claim: CEO 描述成本環境：大宗商品成本上升、降本空間有限
items.quote: a pretty challenging rising commodity cost environment
items.speaker: Mark Widmar (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 稱當前是降成本最困難的時期之一
items.quote: probably one of the most challenging times that we've been in
items.speaker: Mark Widmar (CEO)

items.claim: 研發費用含部分不再用於技術路線圖的研發設備減損
items.quote: impairment of certain R&D equipment
items.speaker: Alexander Bradley (CFO)

items.claim: CEO 表示優先看價格、合約品質與風險分配，而非短期訂單量
items.quote: we continue to prioritize pricing, contract quality
items.speaker: Mark Widmar (CEO)

items.claim: 南卡完工廠第一階段預計 2026 下半年開始生產
items.quote: first phase of the finishing facility remains on track
items.speaker: Mark Widmar (CEO)

items.claim: Series 6 尺寸鈣鈦礦試產線預計 2027 上半年達運作就緒
items.quote: operational readiness in the first half of 2027
items.speaker: Mark Widmar (CEO)

items.claim: CFO 稱 232 結果出來後會盡快形成對東南亞產能的看法
items.quote: We would expect to evaluate that and have a view shortly thereafter.
items.speaker: Alexander Bradley (CFO)

items.claim: CEO 表示不會放棄降低投入成本
items.quote: we're never going to give up on the input costs
items.speaker: Mark Widmar (CEO)

items.claim: 新訂單優先要求現金流動性擔保
items.quote: having cash liquid security against new bookings
items.speaker: Mark Widmar (CEO)

items.claim: 季末淨現金約 17 億美元，在目標區間 15–20 億內
items.quote: approximately $1.7 billion of net cash
items.speaker: Alexander Bradley (CFO)

items.claim: 上半年營運現金流出 3.6 億美元
items.quote: Operating cash outflows year-to-date were $360 million
items.speaker: Alexander Bradley (CFO)

items.claim: 上半年資本支出 2.8 億美元
items.quote: First half capital expenditures were $280 million
items.speaker: Alexander Bradley (CFO)

items.claim: CEO 表示持續投入大量資本於鈣鈦礦商業化
items.quote: continue to invest substantial capital in our efforts
items.speaker: Mark Widmar (CEO)

items.claim: CFO 提到可運用資產負債表協助供應商擴產以換取遠期定價
items.quote: We could try and leverage our position of
items.speaker: Alexander Bradley (CFO)

items.claim: CFO 對併購表示較過去更願意、更開放，但強調紀律
items.quote: So we are more willing to do that.
items.speaker: Alexander Bradley (CFO)

items.claim: 東南亞可全流程完工產能約 1.8 GW，待 232 結果再決定
items.quote: about 1.8 gigawatts of end-to-end fully finished capacity
items.speaker: Alexander Bradley (CFO)

items.claim: 東南亞產能決策等待 232 結果
items.quote: we're really waiting for the outcome of the 232
items.speaker: Alexander Bradley (CFO)

items.claim: 南卡第二階段完工時間改為 2027 年中，並稱可更早納入 CuRe
items.quote: we now expect completion in mid-2027
items.speaker: Mark Widmar (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 稱 CuRe 量產與田間表現優於預期
items.quote: We are pleased with the performance of CuRe
items.speaker: Mark Widmar (CEO)

items.claim: 已開始發出合約 CuRe 價格調整項的首批客戶通知
items.quote: initiated our first customer notifications
items.speaker: Alexander Bradley (CFO)

items.claim: 2026 年 CuRe 銷售的 ASP 上行有限
items.quote: expect limited ASP upside from CuRe sales in 2026
items.speaker: Alexander Bradley (CFO)

items.claim: Series 6 尺寸鈣鈦礦試產線進度符合時程
items.quote: Series 6 form factor pilot line remains on schedule
items.speaker: Mark Widmar (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 對 FCC 逆變器裁決：認為近期不會構成限制
items.quote: I don't see it being a constraint near term.
items.speaker: Mark Widmar (CEO)

items.claim: 在手訂單 45.1 GW
items.quote: our contracted backlog totaled 45.1 gigawatts
items.speaker: Alexander Bradley (CFO)

items.claim: 自上次財報新增美國毛訂單約 1.9 GW
items.quote: approximately 1.9 gigawatts of additional U.S. gross bookings
items.speaker: Alexander Bradley (CFO)

items.claim: 新增美國訂單平均售價約每瓦 0.36 美元（含技術調整項）
items.quote: average selling price of approximately $0.36 per watt
items.speaker: Alexander Bradley (CFO)

items.claim: 美國完全整合產線產能已大致被承諾至 2028 年
items.quote: substantially committed through 2028
items.speaker: Alexander Bradley (CFO)

items.claim: 在手訂單約 41 GW 含某種形式的本土含量要求
items.quote: Approximately 41 gigawatts of our 45-gigawatt
items.speaker: Mark Widmar (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 描述超大規模資料中心業者需求
items.quote: somewhat insatiable demand from hyperscalers
items.speaker: Mark Widmar (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 稱 7 月已簽近 2 GW 美國訂單
items.quote: we booked almost 2 gigawatts in the
items.speaker: Mark Widmar (CEO)

items.claim: 另有超過 2 GW 在合約中但附帶先決條件（CP）
items.quote: There's about 2 more gigawatts, north of 2 gigawatts
items.speaker: Mark Widmar (CEO)

items.claim: 另有約 2 GW 洽談中，CEO 稱年底前高機率成交
items.quote: we can close through by the end of the year
items.speaker: Mark Widmar (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 確認有客戶因等待政策而觀望
items.quote: customers that are sitting on the sidelines
items.speaker: Mark Widmar (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 說明 1.9 GW 訂單多數發生在 7 月（季末之後）
items.quote: So most of that happened in July
items.speaker: Mark Widmar (CEO)

items.claim: Section 232 結果尚未公布，CEO 仍樂觀認為結果將具建設性
items.quote: we're still optimistic that the outcome will be constructive.
items.speaker: Mark Widmar (CEO)

items.claim: CFO 指 Section 301 產能過剩調查仍有風險
items.quote: There is still risk around 301 relating to excess capacity
items.speaker: Alexander Bradley (CFO)

items.claim: CEO 反對 232 設豁免或配額
items.quote: we don't believe that they should be allowed
items.speaker: Mark Widmar (CEO)

items.claim: CFO 描述競爭格局：多數競爭對手為中國企業且規則不同
items.quote: the vast majority of our competitors are Chinese
items.speaker: Alexander Bradley (CFO)

items.claim: CFO 認為國安性質的 232 設carve-out不合理
items.quote: doesn't make a lot of sense to have a carve-out
items.speaker: Alexander Bradley (CFO)

items.claim: CEO 確認 CuRe 技術已在 Perrysburg 完成導入，首條 Series 6 產線爬坡符合預期
items.quote: the CuRe launch is complete in Perrysburg
items.speaker: Mark Widmar

items.claim: CuRe 技術調整可望為 backlog 帶來最高 6 億美元額外營收，主要落在 2027-2028 年
items.quote: $0.6 billion of additional revenue from technology adjusters
items.speaker: Mark Widmar

items.claim: CEO 重申技術策略前提：客戶買的是全生命週期發電量，不是單純名牌效率
items.quote: buy lifetime energy, not just nameplate efficiency
items.speaker: Mark Widmar

items.claim: Perovskite 技術可靠度已達可比業界最佳 R&D 成果的水準
items.quote: reliability results that we believe are comparable to
items.speaker: Mark Widmar

items.claim: CFO 確認 2026 年第一季毛利率明顯擴張，帶動單季每股盈餘創紀錄
items.quote: margin expansion and record Q1 diluted EPS of $3.22
items.speaker: Alexander Bradley

items.claim: CFO 確認南卡羅來納州加工產線進度符合 2026 年第四季排程
items.quote: Carolina finishing line remains on schedule for Q4 2026
items.speaker: Alexander Bradley

items.claim: CFO 確認路易斯安那州廠已完成試車並啟動商業化生產
items.quote: initiated commercial production at our Louisiana facility
items.speaker: Alexander Bradley

qa_flags.question: Brian Lee (Goldman)：Section 232 時程與 $0.40/W 以上價格下限的看法
qa_flags.response_pattern: CEO 未回應價格下限數字，表示不願給內部判斷（'I don't want to give kind of our internal read'），僅稱仍演進中、保持樂觀

qa_flags.question: Philip Shen (ROTH)：232 是否會在 8 月公布或延到秋季
qa_flags.response_pattern: CEO 未給時間點，稱無法提供更強的信心（'I can't really give you a strong view on that'），改談希望正確實施
